incoming.name: Dodo
incoming.excerpt: The Dodo is the symbol and mascot of the Durrell Wildlife Conservation Trust and the Jersey Zoological Park, founded by Gerald Durrell.

incoming.name: Gerald Durrell
incoming.excerpt: Durrell founded the Jersey Zoological Park in 1958 to house his growing collection of animals.
